sentences.text: Minneapolis -LRB- -LSB- mɪniˈæpəlɪs -RSB- -RRB- is the county seat of Hennepin County , and the larger of the Twin Cities , the 16th-largest metropolitan area in the United States .	Hennepin County	Hennepin County, Minnesota	County	List of counties in Minnesota	Hennepin	Hennepin County, Minnesota	16th	List of Metropolitan Statistical Areas	county seat	county seat	Twin Cities	Minneapolis–Saint Paul	16th-largest metropolitan area in the United States	List of Metropolitan Statistical Areas

As of 2015 , Minneapolis is the largest city in the state of Minnesota and 46th-largest in the United States with a population of 410,939 .	Minnesota	Minnesota	46th	List of United States cities by population	state	U.S. state	46th-largest in the United States	List of United States cities by population
Minneapolis and Saint Paul anchor the second-largest economic center in the Midwest , after Chicago .	Saint Paul	Saint Paul, Minnesota	Midwest	American Midwest	Chicago	Chicago

Minneapolis lies on both banks of the Mississippi River , just north of the river 's confluence with the Minnesota River , and adjoins Saint Paul , the state 's capital .	Saint Paul	Saint Paul, Minnesota	Minnesota	Minnesota	state	U.S. state	Mississippi River	Mississippi River	Minnesota River	Minnesota River

The city is abundantly rich in water , with thirteen lakes , wetlands , the Mississippi River , creeks and waterfalls , many connected by parkways in the Chain of Lakes and the Grand Rounds National Scenic Byway .	Mississippi River	Mississippi River	thirteen lakes	list of lakes in Minneapolis	Chain of Lakes	Chain of Lakes (Minneapolis)	Grand Rounds National Scenic Byway	Grand Rounds Scenic Byway
It was once the world 's flour milling capital and a hub for timber .	milling	mill (grinding)

The city and surrounding region is the primary business center between Chicago and Seattle , with Minneapolis proper containing America 's fifth-highest concentration of Fortune 500 companies .	Chicago	Chicago	Seattle	Seattle	Fortune 500	Fortune 500
As an integral link to the global economy , Minneapolis is categorized as a global city .	global city	global city

Noted for its strong music and performing arts scenes , Minneapolis is home to both the award-winning Guthrie Theater and the historic First Avenue nightclub .	Guthrie Theater	Guthrie Theater	First Avenue nightclub	First Avenue (nightclub)

Reflecting the region 's status as an epicenter of folk , funk , and alternative rock music , the city served as the launching pad for several of the 20th century 's most influential musicians , including Bob Dylan and Prince .	Bob Dylan	Bob Dylan	Prince	Prince (musician)

The name Minneapolis is attributed to Charles Hoag , the city 's first schoolteacher , who combined mni , a Dakota Sioux word for water , and polis , the Greek word for city .	Dakota	Dakota language	Greek	Greek language	Charles Hoag	Charles Hoag	Dakota Sioux	Sioux language
